lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a multi-row horizontal grid posterior to the gill slits, with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima within each horizontal row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, creating a discernible checkerboard-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible: one along the dorsal midline and two lower lateral carinae, each exhibiting a high-contrast transition from illuminated upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily near the base and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of numerous commensal fish, including remoras attached to the ventral surface and smaller fish (pilot fish) clustered near the head and pectoral fin regions.
